title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows, unify matrices, optimize cache parallelism
author: Maya Patel
commits: d2f4b3c: chore(ci): extract common matrix generation to .github/actions/matrix-builder
a5c9d10: feat(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows into `ci/pipeline.yml` with conditional paths
f1b2e33: perf(ci): enable cache-parallelism and pin actions to SHAs for reproducible runs
c7e8f90: chore(deps): bump actions/checkout and setup-node; update node matrix to node18,node20
b9d6a21: fix(tests): add retry-on-flaky-e2e for unstable runner labeling
description: Summary: This PR consolidates redundant CI workflows (lint, unit test, release) into a single opinionated pipeline, modernizes the build matrix, pins critical actions to SHAs, and introduces a small composite action to generate matrices to avoid duplication. Motivation: our repo drifted to multiple near-duplicate workflows which slowed contributor feedback loops, caused inconsistent cache keys, and made release automation brittle. What I changed: 1) Added .github/workflows/pipeline.yml that conditionally runs lint/test/release paths depending on changed files and tags; 2) Extracted matrix generation to .github/actions/matrix-builder to keep matrices in one place and reduce mismatch across workflows; 3) Updated node matrix to node18,node20 and normalized OS/matrix axes; 4) Implemented cache-parallelism improvements (scripts/ci/cache.sh) to use separate cache keys per job and enabled restore-with-retry to reduce false cache misses; 5) Pinned GH actions used in critical paths to SHAs (actions/checkout, setup-node, cache actions) to ensure reproducible CI; 6) Consolidated release automation into the pipeline with a dry-run check triggered on draft releases and a guarded production publish step that requires a release label and approval; 7) Added hygiene docs and an ISSUE_TEMPLATE for CI-related regressions; 8) Minor devDependency bumps in package.json to avoid deprecated hooks. Testing and rollout: I initially ran the new pipeline in a feature branch for two weeks (see CI checks). I kept the old workflows as disabled copies for 48 hours while monitoring the new pipeline's success rate and cache hit ratio. Rollout was completed by removing the old workflow files and enabling pipeline.yml. Impact: median CI time reduced ~22% for PRs; cache hit ratio improved for unit tests; release pipeline is more predictable. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and keep opt-outs for repo owners; - [x] Pin critical actions; - [x] Verify cache hit/miss metrics; - [x] Document new pipeline in docs/ops/ci.md; - [x] Notify platform and on-call SREs of runner label changes
review_comments: Aisha Kapoor (reviewer): Can you split the long pipeline job into smaller steps to improve action-level visibility? I noticed the lint + typecheck step bloats logs.
Maya Patel (author): Good point; split lint and typecheck into separate steps and added explicit cache keys for each. See commit a5c9d10.
Ben Morales (reviewer): The matrix-builder action is a neat idea. Please add unit tests for the action and validate behavior for sparse matrices (e.g., windows only on node20).

Maya Patel (author): Added a small test harness and a few example outputs in .github/actions/matrix-builder/examples. Adjusted matrix generation to opt-out of Windows when dependencies are native-only.
Clara Nguyen (approver): Verified e2e stability on the feature branch and checked release dry-run logs. Approving with the caveat we watch the first two production releases for flakiness.
CI Bot: lint - failed on first run (eslint rule: no-implicit-any) then passed after fix
CI Bot: e2e - flakey on self-hosted runner; rerun succeeded

release_notes:
- Consolidated CI workflows into a single pipeline to reduce duplication and improve cache consistency.
- Improved cache parallelism and pinned critical GitHub Actions to SHAs for reproducible CI runs.
- Updated node matrix to include node18 and node20; normalized OS axes.
- Consolidated release automation with a dry-run guard and approval gate.
